# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is emotionless and exceptionally quiet, suffering from a severe inability to hold or participate in a conversation. Despite his shyness and social awkwardness, he possesses a proud admiration for Nell Harcourt.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P40](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0040)_

## Traits

- Large and overweight  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Incapable of easy conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Fearful of social invitations from strangers  <sub>[v1 c33 P40](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0040)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a team and double-seated buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P40](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0040)</sub>

## History

Barney drove his sister Odette, Nell Harcourt, and Isolde Pembroke in a double-seated buggy to a concert held at the Pale Sands Hotel. During the trip, he insisted that Nell sit on the front seat beside him and felt immense pride at driving alongside her, though he struggled to respond to her conversation attempts. Upon arriving at the hotel, he avoided the post-concert supper out of sheer dread of being invited to join the formal gathering, but waited faithfully outside with his team to drive the girls safely home.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P40](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0040)_
